services.name: Tightline Fishing Charters
services.desc: What should you bring for a fishing charter? Most customers bring a cooler for lunch and beverages. We do not provide alcoholic beverages to our customers; however, feel free to bring your own. We recommend wearing many layers of clothing. The weather is always tricky and it is better to have extra clothing to keep warm. Shoes that are comfortable and nonskid would be perfect for wearing on the back deck. Open-toed shoes are not always the best because of the hooks! Many customers also bring along a camera.
